subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The village learned that a tool is only fair when the system around it is fair too.”?
options: Clean water requires both technology and care for people.
It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.
It requires reading carefully when people are trying to win your trust.
Discovery sometimes requires leaving the comfortable path that technology builds around you.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The village learned that a tool is only fair when the system around it is fair too. Clean water requires both technology…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It requires reading carefully when people are trying to win your trust.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Discovery sometimes requires leaving the comfortable path that technology builds around you.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The village learned that a tool is only fair when the system around it is fair too. Clean water requires both technology and care…」，答案為「Clean water requires both technology and care for people.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Clean water requires both technology and care for people.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
